label: PF Backlog 70
title: Backend: build-time separation of operator vs customer packages (operator APIs absent in customer build)
body: Owner concern: customers must NOT be able to discover operator/onboarding/licensing-management surfaces by reading the shipped code or flipping settings. Decision: BUILD-TIME separation from one codebase. (1) Platform/Operator build = onboarding + customer mgmt + licensing admin + operator console (our instance/SaaS). (2) Customer/Tenant build = only the tenant dashboard + their admin; operator modules/routes/APIs are EXCLUDED at build time (separate entry / dead-code elimination), NOT merely hidden. (3) Operator APIs live only in the operator backend so a customer instance has nothing to call. (4) Defense-in-depth: INSTANCE_ROLE + platform_admin gating still applied. (5) Licensing caveat: the customer build contains license VALIDATION (to enforce their tier) but not the operator console; use signed licenses + periodic/offline validation + tamper-evidence. Refs: forge:instance-role-separation (BI-0069), forge:lic-* items.
